pet_notes: STYLE UPGRADE, preserve exact existing raccoon identity/proportions/outfit: small slightly skinny gray-brown raccoon, dark eye-mask patches, large round dark wet eyes with tiny clean white highlights, pale cream muzzle, charcoal pompom beanie with mustard ribbed cuff, dark teal oversized jacket and mustard scarf, green first-aid satchel with pale cross on screen-left, fluffy ringed tail on screen-right. Persona unlucky, innocent, nervous, vulnerable, hunched shoulders. New style clean Japanese anime chibi cel animation: sharp dark charcoal variable-width ink outlines, flat clean color shapes, just one or two hard-edged shadow tones, simplified fur tufts, legible broad tail rings, limited crisp beanie ribs. NO grain, fuzzy hair texture, pencil hatching, weathered speckles, watercolor, soft gradients, blur, glow or white sticker rim. Retain previous motion repairs: upright stable head during thinking, no alternating head roll or dislocated neck; attached head/scarf/shoulders move coherently. No new props, text, shadows or detached effects.
